title: Nice chickpeas dish
preamble:
chickpeas: 1 tin (400g), drained (the main low-carb starch substitute).

Chard Leaves: Stems removed, leaves roughly chopped.

Large Tomato: 1, chopped.

Onion: 1 medium, diced.

Garlic: 2 cloves, sliced or minced.
ingredients: chickpeas: 1 tin (400g), drained (the main low-carb starch substitute).
Chard Leaves: Stems removed, leaves roughly chopped.
Fresh Herbs: Rosemary, thyme, or oregano (finely chopped).
method: Sauté the base: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Fry the onion and your fresh herbs (like rosemary or thyme) for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Deglaze with sherry: Pour in the sherry. Let it bubble rapidly for 1 to 2 minutes until the alcohol smell cooks off and the liquid reduces by half.
Add tomato & chickpeas: Stir in the chopped tomato and chickpeas.
Cover the pan and simmer for 5-7 minutes until the tomatoes soften and create a light sauce.Wilt the chard:
Pile the chopped chard leaves on top.
Cover with the lid for 2 minutes to let them steam.
Stir the wilted leaves into the chickpea mixture, cook for 1 more minute, and serve hot next to your pork chops.
